summary: AEL is a Edison, NJ forensic-engineering consultancy (founded 1983, LinkedIn lists 51-200 employees) that runs three divisions from one facility: an engineering division producing investigation and expert-witness work, Affiliated MRD's materials-testing laboratory, and a telecom/IT arm (Affiliated Technology Solutions) with its own website. Work arrives through a web 'new project' form, a callback request, or a dedicated project-team phone line, and is staffed by roughly 32 named Professional Engineers whose CVs are requested manually per engineer. The public evidence points to a document- and coordination-heavy practice (case intake, PE-authored reports, CV packages) with very little automation visible on the web side.

facts.fact: Company describes itself as a New Jersey professional service company with three divisions: Engineering (forensic investigations, expert witness testimony), a complete Materials Testing & Research facility, and a Technology Services division doing PC/telephony systems integration.

Site states AEL has provided technical services to legal and non-legal sectors for over 30 years from its Edison, NJ facility; its LinkedIn company page lists Founded 1983, HQ Edison NJ, 51-200 employees, 35 employees shown.
Laboratory contact page lists Affiliated MRD at 777 New Durham Road, Edison, New Jersey 08817, email lab@affiliatedinc.net, tel (732) 225-9050.

New-project portal offers three intake paths: submit an assignment online via form, request a callback at a convenient time, or call the Project Team directly at 732-429-1293 (email newproject@aelgroup.net).
Team page lists 32 named Professional Engineers / Ph.D. staff plus Thomas W. Welsh, each linked to an individual bio page.

Careers page states the firm is currently seeking licensed Professional Engineers with a minimum of five years experience to conduct investigations and review evidence across civil, structural, mechanical and electrical matters, and stresses strong verbal, analytical and writing skills.

Engineering division service lines listed: automotive failure analysis, fire origin & causation, explosion origin & causation, structural & construction analysis, electrical systems and work practices, machine design, metallurgical & materials, surface friction analysis, vehicle accident reconstruction.

Laboratory capability list includes SEM with EDS, light optical microscopy, metallography, mechanical/hardness testing, corrosion studies, XRD/XRF/FTIR/wet chemistry, physical testing, contract research and soil analysis.

Sister brand Affiliated Technology Solutions (affiliatedtech.com) sells integrated telecommunications, network, security and managed services, advertises 30+ years of network experience, and carries a named customer testimonial praising quick response and support.
The technology division markets AI features in its phone platform, including AI-driven call summaries, call transcription/sentiment review and AI background-noise cancellation.
Engineering bio pages carry actions to request the engineer's CV or request that engineer on a new project, routed through email/forms rather than an automated system.
Third-party profile on iHire describes AEL as serving the legal and non-legal community since 1983 and currently lists no job openings ('Your search did not match any current openings').

operations_signals: Case intake is human-routed through three parallel channels (online assignment form, callback request, direct project-team phone 732-429-1293) with a separate main/lab line at (732) 225-9050 - two different numbers for two entry points (https://www.aelgroup.net/newprojects)
Site pushes phone contact for urgency: the team page and projects page both tell prospects to 'call now ... for Immediate Assistance' rather than book online (https://www.aelgroup.net/team-members)
No online scheduling, client portal, quote calculator or e-commerce found; the only web intake mechanisms are Wix forms plus mailto links (https://www.aelgroup.net/newprojects)
CV and expert-placement requests are handled one engineer at a time through a 'Request CV / Request Engineer on New Project' action on each bio page (https://www.aelgroup.net/bpl)

Three divisions run under separate brands, emails and phone numbers (aelgroup.net / affiliatedinc.net lab address / affiliatedtech.com tech brand), so inquiries split across inboxes and lines (https://www.aelgroup.net/contact-mrd)
Public materials claim consulting services worldwide plus expert witness testimony, implying travel and multi-jurisdiction scheduling coordination (https://www.aelgroup.net/)
No published office hours, after-hours coverage statement or turnaround/response-time commitment found on the home, contact, projects or careers pages (https://www.aelgroup.net/)
hiring_signals: Open call for licensed Professional Engineers with 5+ years experience to investigate and review evidence in civil, structural, mechanical and electrical matters, with explicit emphasis on writing skills - i.e., hiring for report-producing capacity (https://www.aelgroup.net/careers)
No current postings on the company's iHire profile page, which instead invites candidates to a talent network (https://www.ihire.com/orgs/323758/affiliated-engineering)

SimplyHired returns zero results for the exact company name, suggesting the firm does not run broad job-board campaigns (https://www.simplyhired.com/search?q=%22affiliated+engineering+laboratories%22)

LinkedIn company page shows 35 people associated with the company and a 51-200 size band, consistent with a mid-size professional staff rather than a large back office (https://www.linkedin.com/company/affiliated-engineering-laboratories-inc-)
No postings found for administrative, intake, scheduling, billing or report-production roles in any source checked (https://www.simplyhired.com/search?q=%22affiliated+engineering+laboratories%22)
review_themes: No customer review content could be retrieved: Google Business Profile, Yelp and BBB pages either blocked automated access or surfaced no indexed profile, so client satisfaction themes are unknown (https://www.aelgroup.net/)

The only review source found was employer-review sites: Glassdoor shows a very small number of employee reviews (two, per the search listing), one titled 'Must be strong spirited' - far too few to characterize (https://www.glassdoor.com/Reviews/Affiliated-Engineering-Laboratories-Reviews-E4486309.htm)

The firm's own marketing carries one named customer testimonial from a telecom customer praising knowledgeable support and fast response, which is a vendor-published sample, not independent review data (https://www.affiliatedtech.com/)

A directory listing categorizes the business under 'Computer Software & Services' with a phone number that differs from the company's published numbers, an indication that third-party business data about AEL is stale or inconsistent (https://www.yellowpagesdirectory.com/Edison-NJ/Affiliated+Engineering+Laboratories+Inc/229488)
tech_footprint: Both websites are Wix-built (Wix Thunderbolt generator tag), a low-cost DIY platform with no custom application layer visible (https://www.aelgroup.net/)

Sitemap contains about 75 URLs, including many one-off pages (invitations, holiday greetings, per-initial bio pages), which suggests the site is maintained ad hoc rather than through a content plan (https://www.aelgroup.net/pages-sitemap.xml)
At least one team bio page still shows template placeholder text ('Title Here', 'Need Write-up'), evidence that web content upkeep lags behind operations (https://www.aelgroup.net/tww)
No live chat, chatbot, booking widget, CRM embed or customer portal detected on the pages reviewed; contact is a Wix form plus mailto and phone (https://www.aelgroup.net/newprojects)

Company maintains a LinkedIn company page (Edison HQ, 343 followers at time of review) but no visible content marketing, blog or case-study library on the site (https://www.linkedin.com/company/affiliated-engineering-laboratories-inc-)

Tech division already resells AI-enabled telephony features (call summaries, transcription, noise cancellation), so the firm has vendor exposure to AI products even though its own engineering workflow appears unautomated (https://www.affiliatedtech.com/ai)
growth_signals: A 2010 archived version of the site described only two divisions (Engineering and Materials Testing); the current site lists a third, Technology Services, indicating service-line expansion over time (http://web.archive.org/web/20100917031041/http://aelgroup.net/ael/index.html)

A state-registry aggregator lists 'AFFILIATED ENGINEERING LABORATORIES, P.C.' as a foreign professional service corporation registered with the New York Department of State in June 2025 at the Edison address, consistent with expansion into New York work (https://opengovny.com/corporation/7636063)
Firm claims it performs consulting services worldwide and provides expert witness testimony, a scope that grows with litigation and insurance demand (https://www.aelgroup.net/)
Longevity and scale signals: founded 1983, 'over 30 years' of service, 51-200 employee band on LinkedIn (https://www.linkedin.com/company/affiliated-engineering-laboratories-inc-)

The technology arm markets 30+ years of network experience and an expanding feature set (AI call insights, FieldMobile, integrated video conferencing), showing a second growth vector alongside forensic engineering (https://www.affiliatedtech.com/)

BuildZoom lists the firm under NJ Certificate of Authorization license 24GA28114400, i.e., a licensed engineering firm of record for construction-related work (https://www.buildzoom.com/contractor/affiliated-engineering-laboratories)
decision_maker: Unknown - no owner, president or GM title is published on the company's own site or its LinkedIn company page; the team page lists 32+ named Professional Engineers with credentials but no titles, and the only non-P.E. name shown (Thomas W. Welsh) carries a template placeholder instead of a title (https://www.aelgroup.net/team-members)

inferences.inference: Report production, not case acquisition, is likely the operational bottleneck.
inferences.reasoning: The careers ad hires PEs specifically for investigation, evidence review and writing, and the site markets expert-witness reports and failure analyses; that work is document-heavy and each case produces a bespoke long-form deliverable, so throughput scales with authoring capacity rather than lead flow.

inferences.inference: Intake triage and callback scheduling are manual, with no self-service qualification.
inferences.reasoning: Prospects either fill a generic Wix form that promises 'our office will contact you directly', request a callback, or phone the project team; there is no scheduling tool, qualification questionnaire routing, or acknowledgment automation visible, so a person must read, triage and assign each inquiry.

inferences.inference: Administrative load is duplicated across three brands and multiple inboxes/phone lines.
inferences.reasoning: AEL engineering, the Affiliated MRD lab and Affiliated Technology Solutions each publish separate emails and numbers (aelgroup.net, affiliatedinc.net, affiliatedtech.com), so a single client relationship can generate parallel threads with no visible shared system.

inferences.inference: Marketing and web maintenance are under-resourced relative to the headcount.
inferences.reasoning: A 51-200 person firm still shows template placeholder text on a bio page, keeps orphan invitation/holiday pages in its sitemap, and publishes no case studies or blog, which is consistent with engineers and office staff doing web updates as a side task.

inferences.inference: The tech division is a plausible internal champion or channel for AI adoption.
inferences.reasoning: Affiliated Technology Solutions already sells AI call summarization and transcription to its telecom customers, so leadership has exposure to AI product language and an existing vendor relationship; an agentic workflow pitch may land better framed as an extension of that offering.

inferences.inference: Case intake volume is probably steady but litigation-driven and seasonal, not consumer-paced.
inferences.reasoning: Clients are law firms, insurers and industrial/non-legal buyers per the site's own description, and there are no consumer reviews or online booking, so demand arrives in bursts tied to claims and assignments rather than continuous retail traffic.

data_gaps: No customer reviews retrievable: Google Business Profile, Yelp and BBB blocked automated access or returned no indexed profile, so client satisfaction, complaint themes and star ratings are unknown.
Glassdoor and Indeed review pages were blocked by bot verification; only search-result titles were visible, so employee sentiment could not be assessed.

No current job postings found beyond the evergreen careers-page PE call; SimplyHired returned zero results for the exact company name, iHire showed no openings, and LinkedIn/Indeed/ZipRecruiter job pages were inaccessible.
Careers page contains only a short evergreen statement; the page body would not fully render, so any listed openings or application instructions beyond that statement are unconfirmed.
Office hours, after-hours/emergency coverage, service-area radius and typical turnaround times are not published anywhere reviewed.
Employee headcount is uncertain: LinkedIn shows a 51-200 self-reported band with 35 associated members, while other aggregators label it a 'small employer'; no authoritative count obtained.
Revenue, case volume, billing/AR systems, CRM, and whether any internal document management or practice-management software is used could not be determined from public sources.

Decision-maker identity and titles are not published; ownership/principals could not be confirmed without a paid business database or state filing that was inaccessible (opengovny and OpenCorporates returned 403/JS-only pages).

The NY registration detail (June 2025, DOS #7636063) comes from a search-result snippet of a state-registry aggregator whose page itself returned HTTP 403, so it is second-hand and unverified at the source.
